Simpler: replace assertThrows with try-catch and fail. Also remove @Mock annotations and use Mockito.mock.

Also BaseBarSeries constructors: need to use appropriate constructor; there is BaseBarSeries(String name, Function<Number, Num> numFactory) maybe? Maybe library version older. Alternative: Use new BaseBarSeries(name) then set numFactory via series.setNumFactory? Not sure. Simpler: Instead of extending BaseBarSeries, we can create a custom BarSeries implementation that returns negative count. Could implement BarSeries interface with minimal methods. But easier: modify NegativeBarCountSeries to extend BaseBarSeries using constructor BaseBarSeries(String) then override getBarCount. Use super("negative");.

Also MockBarSeries not exists; we can replace with createSeries method to generate deterministic series; we already have createSeries. So replace usage of MockBarSeries with createSeries.

- Use MockitoAnnotations.openMocks(this) maybe not needed because we will not use @Mock; we'll create mocks via Mockito.mock.
- In test methods that had parameters with @Mock, change to create mocks inside method.

- For assertThrows, replace with try-catch and fail.

- Adjust imports: import org.junit.Before; import org.junit.Test; import static org.junit.Assert.*; import org.mockito.Mockito; import org.mockito.Mock; maybe not needed.

- Ensure NumericIndicator.of(null) test expects NullPointerException; need to assert exception.

Currently test just calls NumericIndicator.of(null); should expect NPE. Use try-catch.

- Also test volumeWithNegativeBarCountSeriesThrowsIllegalArgumentException expects IllegalArgumentException. Use try-catch.

- Ensure we have access to NumericIndicator class (exists). Use static method NumericIndicator.volume(series).

- Ensure we have import for org.ta4j.core.indicators.helpers.VolumeIndicator; already.
